stage: CP39 figures (directive Phase F) — five figures, no more

fig1_bracket.content: chance, best chain arm, coordinate GNN, cell-metric RF, best model arm, best frontier, oracle; every bar labelled with input modality and K
fig1_bracket.correction_standing: the 0.8905 bar is a TABULAR classifier on lattice metrics, not a graph network; the project's coordinate GNN is 0.4889 with its seed error bar. Oracle bar is CP25's eval-set 0.9524.

fig2_visibility.content: four conditions O0/O1/O2/O3, both eval sets, O3 control visible

fig3_noimage.content: with-image against formula-only per model, 13 scored, chance line, significance starred
fig3_noimage.defect_caught_in_build: my first version printed '4 of 13 significant' because I took len() of the 'significant' SUMMARY DICT (4 keys) instead of its n field (10). Corrected and cross-checked against a recomputation from the per-model p-values, which also gives 10.

fig4_cue_sufficiency.content: pixel-minus-RF gap by stratum, three arms, both samples, zero line drawn
fig4_cue_sufficiency.caption_carries_the_confound: the ambiguous stratum is 60/70 and 58/69 hexagonal-or-trigonal and the residual n is 10 and 12 — both stated on the figure itself rather than only in the text

fig5_generational.content: left: the single generational pair by stratum with the oracle ceiling and chance drawn; right: the same gains normalised by headroom-to-oracle
fig5_generational.why_two_panels: the raw panel alone would license the false reading that the newer generation closes the ambiguous gap faster. Normalised it closes LESS (54.1% against 64.0%). Both panels ship because the raw numbers are what a reader will compute, and the normalisation is what corrects them.
fig5_generational.no_trend_language: enforced — one pair is a comparison

render_then_verify: each new figure was rendered, read back visually, and defects fixed before saving: fig5's first render had the delta annotation colliding with the legend and the caption sitting behind a bar; both fixed and a programmatic bounding-box overlap check now returns 0.
